verdict.rationale: Sift's docs say it integrates into your existing systems through its own REST APIs and SDKs, and that the merchant sends event and payment data from their own application rather than through a specific processor. That implies independence from any one processor's rails, but the evidence never names multiple PSPs, gateways, or platforms. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of supported PSPs/gateways/platforms, any multi-processor integration guide or connectors, independent or hands-on corroboration of processor-agnostic use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use the product across whatever payment stack I run — multiple PSPs, gateways, and platforms — rather than being locked to one processor's rails

citations.quote: Sift easily integrates into your existing systems using modern REST APIs, Javascript snippet, and SDKs for iOS and Android.
You will send this data from your application to Sift via our REST API.
